extracted.stage: Divorce financial remedy proceedings, next hearing listed
extracted.summary: A partner at Calloway Legal LLP enquires about a £55,500 litigation loan for the applicant in a divorce with around £978,000 of assets in dispute, ahead of a hearing at Bristol Family Court on 6 December 2026.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client, which we have logged for review. To take this further we would need confirmation of your client's identity and address details, a breakdown of the costs to be funded, and details of the assets in dispute including any existing charges or encumbrances. It would also help to have confirmation of the stage of proceedings and the nature of the hearing listed on 6 December. Our criteria and application form will follow separately. Nothing in this email constitutes an offer of finance or any indication that funding will be available.
